call_points.text: Q1 execution impacted by West Bengal elections; normalized from May onwards
Alcon signaling expected to contribute ₹120-130 Cr revenue in FY27 at about 20% margin.
FY26 margin gain called structural, not deferred cost; operating leverage has kicked in.
All contracts have price escalation formulas; NHAI and MoRTH now pay escalation monthly.
Debt rose on drawdowns for large EPC contracts and the Alcon buyout; expected to return to prior level.
Middle East war and currency volatility cited as reasons for not guiding above 30% growth.
Sleeper segment margin compressed partly on mark-to-market currency moves in South Africa and Namibia.
Achieved highest-ever annual order inflow of ~₹2,422 Cr, taking total order book to ₹4,476 Cr.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹414.68 Cr (+8.9% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹31.88 Cr (+31.5% YoY).
GPT Infraprojects Limited’s Board declared a ₹1.00 interim dividend per equity share on May 20, 2026.

GPT Infraprojects Limited’s Board of Directors, led by Sonam Lakhotia (Mem No.: A41358), declared a 3rd interim dividend of ₹1.00 per equity share on May 20, 2026, payable by June 18, 2026, with record date May 26, 2026.
GPT Infraprojects reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,290 Cr and PAT of ₹97.3 Cr, backed by a record order book of ₹4,476 Cr.
On 20 May 2026, GPT Infraprojects reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹414.7 Cr and PAT of ₹31.9 Cr.
GPT Infraprojects Limited held a conference call on May 21, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. (IST) to discuss Q4 FY26 financial performance with investors.
GPT Infraprojects' May 21, 2026 earnings call guided FY27 revenue growth of 27-30% and EBITDA margin near 14%, with order inflow of about ₹3,000 Cr.
On 26 May 2026, GPT Infraprojects said it won a ₹72 Cr PSC sleeper supply contract from PCMM, Eastern Railway, to be executed over 730 days, taking its order book to ₹4,548 Cr.

GPT Infraprojects held a Q1FY27 earnings call on August 3, 2026, reporting consolidated revenue of ₹302 Cr (down 3.4% YoY), EBITDA of ₹47.5 Cr (up 28.4% YoY), and reiterating FY27 guidance of 30% revenue growth and 14-15% EBITDA margin.
GPT Infra's WOS Alcon Builders won a ₹149.50 Cr (incl. GST) Western Railway signalling contract for 18 stations in Bhavnagar Division on 16 Oct 2026, taking the order book to ₹5,538 Cr.
GPT Infra's WOS Alcon Builders secured a ₹134.11 Cr Western Railway signalling contract on 17 Oct 2026, increasing the order book to ₹5,651 Cr.
GPT Infra won a ₹27.08 Cr concrete sleeper supply order from AFCONS-KTPL (JV), lifting order book to ₹5,678 Cr.
